_comment: Shared fixtures for the copy-quality gate. Both implementations read this file: worker/test/copygate.test.mjs (TypeScript, the worker path) and tests/unit/test_copy_quality.py (Python, the fleet path). A rule added to one runtime and not the other fails on the same fixture, which is the only defence against the two tables drifting. Rule text was written for this codebase; nothing is copied from a third-party rule set. Every case also pins `score`, the deterministic slop score, so the two scoring implementations cannot drift either.
